# BMSCE IEEE Computer Society

> BMSCE IEEE Computer Society (BMSCE IEEE CS) is the IEEE Computer Society student branch chapter of BMS College of Engineering (BMSCE), Bull Temple Road, Basavanagudi, Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India. Established in 2021, it runs national-level hackathons, hands-on workshops, expert talks and outreach for engineering students, with 2,100+ members, 75+ events and 6 awards.

## Now: Parallax hackathon (30–31 October 2026)

Parallax is a 24-hour national-level cybersecurity hackathon organised by BMSCE IEEE Computer Society as the flagship event of Cyber Month 2026.

- When: 4:00 PM IST, Friday 30 October 2026 to 4:00 PM IST, Saturday 31 October 2026
- Mode: hybrid. Each team takes part either fully offline at BMS College of Engineering, Bengaluru, or fully online from anywhere in India (a team cannot split between modes)
- Prize pool: ₹40,000
- Teams: 2 to 4 members, open to students from any college; a team can mix members from different colleges
- Registration fee (per team, not per person): offline ₹310 if the team has at least one IEEE member, otherwise ₹450; online ₹200 if the team has at least one IEEE member, otherwise ₹290
- Food: provided for teams taking part offline
- Details and FAQ: https://www.bmsceieeecs.in/cybermonth/events/parallax-hackathon
- Short link: https://www.bmsceieeecs.in/parallax
- Registration form: https://forms.gle/zVmK961gykk4bFa88

## Cyber Month 2026 (17 October – 5 November 2026)

A month of cybersecurity talks, workshops, competitions, a Capture The Flag (CTF) and the Parallax hackathon, run by BMSCE IEEE Computer Society with the partner clubs IEEE EMBS, IEEE WIE, IEEE PES & SC, IEEE PELS & IES, Gradient, OS Code, Singularity and Sensored. Registrations are open for Parallax, Cyber Siege, Don't Trust the Systems and ONLYCTF (workshop 29 October, competition 5 November).

- [Cyber Month 2026](https://www.bmsceieeecs.in/cybermonth): full lineup and schedule
- [Cyber Month for AI assistants](https://www.bmsceieeecs.in/cybermonth/llms.txt): every event with dates, clubs and links
